goal: The lab can decide whether to try GateLite on its own languages: it understands the 2-of-8 routing idea and sees that the gain is real below 10 h but negligible at 50 h.

audience.cares_about: WER gain per hour of labelled data, extra cost
likely_doubts: Is the gain just from more trainable parameters?
Does it hold with more data?
What does routing cost at inference?

sections.name: Problem
sections.key_message: Full fine-tuning overfits below 10 h of labelled speech

sections.name: Idea + method
sections.key_message: Route each frame to 2 of 8 small experts; encoder frozen

sections.name: Results
sections.key_message: -3.5 WER points at 10 h with 3.1% trained parameters; gap closes at 50 h

sections.name: Limits + recommendation
sections.key_message: Worth trying for languages under 10 h; read speech only, +6% latency

qa.question: Is the gain just more trainable parameters?
answer_points: GateLite trains 3.1% of parameters, the dense adapter 4.0%

qa.question: Does it hold with more data?
answer_points: no: at 50 h the two methods are within 0.3 points

qa.question: What does routing cost at inference?
answer_points: routing adds 6% latency on a single GPU
multi-GPU cost not reported in the paper

cuts.reason: kept in the table, not discussed: the lab already uses adapters
one bullet is enough for the decision; weight 0.01 in notes
